UPDATE embedding_reindex_runs
              SET status = 'running',
                  leased_until = now() + ($2::bigint * interval '1 second'),
                  started_at = COALESCE(started_at, now()),
                  updated_at = now()
            WHERE id = $1
              AND status IN ('queued', 'running')
              AND (leased_until IS NULL OR leased_until < now())
